matching.individual: geometry-only reciprocal unique maximum IoU >=0.25; single unit or quantity1 without group contradiction; no value/kind-assisted matching
matching.groupSurface: geometry-only reciprocal unique maximum IoU >=0.25 among group rows, separate from individual score; membership not inferred
matching.ordering: same matched raw set replayed on preimage and candidate, reverse and redelivery
matching.colors: trim/lowercase and frozen Korean/English aliases only; no color-to-owner conversion
matching.attributes: correct/wrong/unknown/missing/observed-unjudged separately; free text not auto wrong; duplicate schema color labels are not independent semantic facts

decision: No invented success percentage; compare each case/property, new errors, useful restore units, time and cost. Synthetic/function success != photo accuracy. Changed/tuned after outputs => development set.
